theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k) (j : Fin k) (t : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, ι v ∈ T) → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → Q = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ L.toLinearMap) → ‖L‖ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ t → (∀ a b : Euclid (n + k), a ∈ T → b ∈ T → |inner ℝ (Q.starProjection a) b - inner ℝ a b| ≤ t * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖) → (∀ e : Euclid (n + k), e ∈ Tᗮ → ‖Q.starProjection e‖ ^ 2 ≤ t * ‖e‖ ^ 2) → ‖(EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp L‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * t ∧ ∀ m : Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ, |m (P (Q.starProjection (ι' (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))) - ∑ i : Fin n, ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp L) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * m (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ t * ‖m‖
